display_long_description:
Right Here Right Now! - The Ultimate Interactive VR Thriller
Step into North Carolina’s first interactive live-action VR film! Directed by D.C. Agwu and Tommy Bowers, Right Here Right Now! completely shatters the boundary between traditional cinema and immersive gaming.  

Live or Die?... Your Choice.
You experience the story through the eyes of Lucas. What begins as a sunny, relaxing picnic date with your girlfriend, Jane, instantly turns into a nightmare when she tearfully accuses you of cheating. 

Before you can even defend yourself, you are both violently kidnapped. 

You awaken in a cold, abandoned warehouse, securely bound to a chair. A sadistic captor rips the tape from your mouth and presents a terrifying loyalty test: which of you should die?. After Janaye completely fails the test by begging the kidnappers to kill you instead, your fate is in your own hands. Do you sacrifice yourself, or throw her to the wolves?.  

Key Features:
Live-Action VR: Experience a stunning 180°/360° visual environment that puts you directly inside the interrogation room.

Branching Narrative: Your dialogue choices actively shape the story. Lie to mend your relationship, confess your toxic secrets, or urgently focus on escaping.  

Pulse-Pounding QTEs: Timed, reflex-based choices mean the difference between a triumphant escape and a fatal gunshot to the back
